plan.title: Donation Analytics Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and repeat donor insights

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Cities by Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Donation Share by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Repeat Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor" AS donor, COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
